learning_outcomes.text: Analyze electronic system testing requirements and develop simple testing solutions to support systems reliability.
Understand automatic test pattern generation and fault simulation principles.
Combine design for testability techniques and apply them in electronic systems.
Develop scan testing and BIST solutions.
Understand the basic fault generation mechanisms in IC’s, the basic fault models and the basic testing algorithms.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and challenges in VLSI testing
Scan testing and architectures (full scan, partial scan, at-speed scan testing)
Built-in self testing – BIST (pattern generation, output response analysis, architectures)
Test Pattern Generation and Fault simulation
Development of built-in self test architectures
Design DfT schemes and apply them to electronic systems
Fault models, defect types and test algorithms for memory IC’s
